description: World Bank funded projects by country from the World Bank Projects API: project name, status, total amount (USD), approval year and project page. Project list only; contract-award notices are not in this source. Related tools on this server, for a different need: energy_world_customs_tariff_wits when you need applied import tariffs from the World Bank WITS / UNCTAD; energy_adb_procurement_notices when you need Asian Development Bank procurement notices: notice title. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: energy_world_bank_procurement
title: World Bank funded projects by country from the World Bank
